🎬 **LAUNCH VIDEO CUT 3 LANDED — `launch-video-cut-3` as `9a216a07d` (drained attended 2026-09-29).** Owner 2026-09-29: "lets do the film cut using Opus - it should not be too long". Opus 5.5 at max effort in wt-lvc3 (687,995 tokens, 05:45Z to 07:47Z; commits `5bcd44971` tooling, `4aaae5bb4` edit notes + the treatment's phase-3 section, `20a8c7e03` evidence, plus the attended `ffd7d96e5` report and verifier cure): five exports under `~/.goldrush/launch-video/cut/` from the 23 phase-2 takes and the plates, nothing generated or bought: the master 1920x1200 (94.000 s, 156,701,247 B, 60 fps), 1920x1080 (147,624,862 B), the vertical 1080x1920 (124,373,170 B), the web export 1280x800 for the landing (18,538,642 B, faststart, poster 253,221 B), a 30 s teaser (29,946,455 B); loudness -14.0 LUFS / -2.2 dBTP (teaser -13.8 / -1.9); the slips in Rye and Wellfleet as PNG overlays (no drawtext here); every movement boundary on the treatment's timecode; fallbacks per the treatment where the footage lacked a shot (no brass flash in B7, the Baron's standard and men for B8, the fixture board kept out of B10, vertical reframes); `assemble.mjs --check` reproduces the cut list byte for byte and a rebuild is byte-identical; evidence 0.8 MB, no video in git. Findings F-LVC3-1 (cured in the landing), F-LVC3-2 (the Baron's taunt card shows 1.3 to 1.5 s), F-LVC3-3 (hurt vignette in many takes), F-LVC3-4 (brand book says masters go to `marketing/reel/`; video stays out of the repo, owner's call), F-LVC3-5/6/7 recorded in the report. THE OWNER WATCHES `gold-rush-launch-film-1920x1200-v1.mp4` and says yes or gives notes (a v2 is one edit to `edl.mjs` and one `assemble.mjs --all`); the landing-page embed is the drafted follow-up `reviews/launch-video-cut-3.md`.

🔧 **LANE EVIDENCE TRACE GUARD 1 LANDED — `lane-evidence-trace-guard-1` as `f19e79de3` (drained attended 2026-09-29).** Authored attended from F-2742-1 (the 108 MB `trace.zip` that GitHub refused for eleven hours). Astra on lane-d, two attempts (attempt 1 self-blocked on my clause, F-ATT-12; attempt 2 `00e7839ba`, 77,722 tokens, 02:28Z to 02:35Z; plus my 5-line review fix on the lane: the runner fixture now removes its `lane-evidence-receipt-*` scratch at test end, after six survived the first landing battery's fixture-teardown guard, F-TEG1-3): `commit_lane_delta` now withholds `**/test-results/**`, `**/*-results/**`, `**/trace.zip`, `**/*.webm`, `**/test-failed-*.png` and any regular `artifacts/**` file over 50,000,000 bytes (measured by `stat`), rename pairs together, each path logged `withheld …` and appended to `<run-log-stem>-withheld-paths.txt`; task-staged raw files are unstaged (baseline index entries untouched); before the commit the runner measures the index against `merge-base main HEAD` with the new `evidence-budget.mjs --staged` and withholds the largest staged `artifacts/**` blobs until the 25,000,000-byte task budget fits; a measurement error withholds the auto-commit itself with an explicit receipt (fail-closed, disk and index retained). Fixtures: 11 raw/oversized paths withheld incl. a 51,000,000-byte `big.bin`; a 26,000,006-byte staging trims its 17,000,000-byte largest file and commits 9,000,006 bytes; exactly 25,000,000 commits untouched; a rename into `x-results/` withheld both sides. `node --test scripts/evidence-budget.test.mjs` 21/21 (14 + 7 new); `runner-commit-decoupling-guard.test.sh` 13/13; `bash -n`, tsc, build green; `src/**` unchanged. Runner pointer shift +83 lines (old 565 → 648, 567 → 650); CLAUDE.md carries no runner coordinates since its 2026-09-25 compaction and the law-pointer guard is green. The live runner process runs the old code until restarted (done attended after this landing per the restart recipe). Landed attended, scripts only `reviews/lane-evidence-trace-guard-1.md`.

📱 **`b1-device-verdict-rows` (B1) — OWNER: ten minutes on your phone, and the device verdict rows are yours to fill.** The 2026-09-19 ruling decided 28 items and left exactly two things with you; this is the first. It is not a design question and nothing is blocked behind it — it wants the device in your pocket, not a decision. **Declared s2644** because the desk carried it unkeyed, which made `desk-carryforward-guard` unable to carry-check it and made the live desk count disagree with what the parser could read (5 declared vs 3 keyable). Keyed now as a backticked slug so it can be tracked across handoffs like any other item.

🔺 **F-2642-3 — OWNER: the registry deploy day is now ACTIONABLE, and the desk entry's own trigger condition has been met.** `docs/OWNER-DESK-2026-09-19.md:100–101` reads *"Astra is landing the registry code behind a closed gate now (lane-b) … I bring you the checklist when the code lands."* **The code has landed (`fdfcab4d0`) and the checklist is `docs/ops/account-registry.md`** — five steps, each with its verification and its rollback sentence. ⚖️ **NOTHING DEPLOYED AND NOTHING MIGRATED, by construction and not by promise: the Pages binding ships as a COMMENTED block in `wrangler.toml` with `ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCOPE` deliberately unset, so both are absent and the door behaves byte-identically to main — which `closed-gate.test.mjs` asserts directly rather than by inspection.** Routine Pages deploys are unaffected. ⛔ **NO FIRE MAY ENABLE THIS**: the five steps need the owner's own deployment inventory, a quiesce of every identity writer including previews, an independently verified private export, a migration secret and a post-bootstrap smoke test of legacy saves — none of which the repo can know or automate. It is on the desk, not on the board.
